title: Terror in the Lake
description: Old Pell's net came back in halves and he will not describe the marks on his hull twice. The lake feeds half of Millbrook and the boats are all sitting. Find what is down there.

objectives.description: Speak with the fishermen still willing to talk about it (0/2)
Examine what's left of Old Pell's net and hull

notes: Named fisherman (Old Pell, invented for this quest only, prose colour) replaces abstract fear. Not connected to the soulstone thread - no touchpoint assignment for this quest in docs/design/quest_web.md.
